title: the first savings hold (account 1, 137.29 MNT) posts AMOUNT_HOLD but leaves the posted balance at 1000.31, reducing available to 863.02
_note: Parity vector transcribed from the post-hold account read-back, capture savings-hold-release/out/savings-hold-after-hold-account-raw.json (GET /savingsaccounts/1?associations=all, tenant gerege, HTTP 200). This is the observation that makes CLAUDE.md line 14 gradeable: the four limbs of 'holds are postings and alter available only, never posted balance' all fall out of the one read-back. request.hold_release.transactions are the account's whole append-only stream in id order — the opening DEPOSIT (id 1, type 1, 1000.000000), the two INTEREST_POSTINGs (id 2 type 3 0.160000, id 3 type 3 0.150000), and the hold row (id 6, transactionType.id 20, amountHold true, amount 137.290000, runningBalance 863.020000). expect.account_balance_minor is summary.accountBalance 1000.31 = 100031 minor, which the hold did NOT move; expect.held_minor is the outstanding AMOUNT_HOLD amount 137.29 = 13729 minor, derived from row id 6 by identity pairing (release_id_of_hold_amount 0); expect.available_minor is summary.availableBalance 863.02 = 86302 = 100031 - 13729, exact with no sub-minor residue. The seam derives the fold over the observed rows and pins the observed cells; it does not read running_balance_derived. A port that folds the hold into the posted balance reports 86302 as account_balance_minor (the oracles AVAILABLE) and 72573 as available; a port that ignores the hold reports 0 held and never lowers available. Nothing was computed by this promotion that the read-back did not record.

provenance.note: The expected cells are transcribed from the committed post-hold account read-back; that one document carries both the summary (accountBalance, availableBalance) and the transaction list, so held, balance and available are all read from a single observed state. capture_case_id is the account number the rows belong to.
